author: pgaudet
body:
Hi, 

GO:0019512    lactose catabolic process via tagatose-6-phosphate will be obsoleted and replaced by its parent : [lactose catabolic process](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005990), see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31932

Can you please update these entries accordingly: 
InterPro	IPR005926	Tagatose-6-phosphate kinase
InterPro	IPR005927	Tagatose 1,6-diphosphate aldolase
InterPro	IPR005928	6-phospho-beta-galactosidase


Thanks, Pascale
title: InterPro2GO issue: Tagatose-6-phosphate kinase

author: pgaudet
source_title: Obsoletion notice: metabolic pathways variants with no manual annotations

author: blazaropinto
body:
Hi Pascale,
Thank you very much for this. I can see the obsoleted GO:0019512 has been removed before starting the procedures for release 109.0, so this change will already be available in the coming InterPro release.
I've added now the parent term to these 3 entries, this will be publicly available in InterPro 110.0.
Best,
Beatriz
